title: UVT projection sidecar
description: The `.uvt.json` sidecar of a UVT projection. Its `ktx2` block copies values that exist in the KTX 2.0 container; everything else is UV-level semantics the container has no place for. A sidecar that contradicts its container is a defect, not a preference.

ktx2.description: Verbatim copies of KTX 2.0 header fields. Never normalised: layerCount stays 0 for a non-array image so the sidecar and the container cannot drift.

pixelDepth.description: 0 for 2D. This profile admits 2D, array and cube topologies only; a volume is reserved, not specified.

faceCount.description: 1, or 6 for a cubemap. A cubemap must be square.

levelCount.description: At least 1. KTX2 encodes 'generate mips at load' as 0, which is a loader instruction rather than a description of the file; a normalized runtime projection states what it contains.

supercompressionScheme.description: The container's own enumeration: 0 none, 1 BasisLZ, 2 Zstandard, 3 ZLIB.

transferFunction.description: The Data Format Descriptor transfer function, restricted to what a runtime texture profile needs. The wider Khronos set is deliberately not admitted until something reads it.

primaries.description: `unspecified` is a real answer: a projection that does not know its primaries says so instead of asserting the common case.

premultipliedAlpha.description: The Data Format Descriptor alpha-premultiplied flag, copied verbatim.

alphaMode.description: UV-level alpha semantics, not a restatement of the container flag. `premultiplied` requires color.premultipliedAlpha to be true.

orientation.description: KTXorientation in S-then-T form. A UVT projection must state it: a runtime cannot recover it from the pixels.

swizzle.description: KTXswizzle, when the container carries one. Four characters from rgba01.

sampler.description: How a runtime should bind the texture. Advice the projection carries, required so that no consumer has to guess.
